mapper.select: SELECT tplu.user_id as userId, tplu.financial_user_id as financialUserId, su.username as userName, su.real_name as realName, su.phone as phone, tpl.code as province FROM tax_place_location_user tplu LEFT JOIN tax_place_location tpl on tplu.tax_place_location_id = tpl.id and tpl.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su on tplu.user_id = su.id and su.deleted = 0 WHERE tplu.deleted = 0 AND tpl.code = #{province}
